lines.text: Many learners say: I am agree with you.
Agree is a verb. No am.

data.why: Agree is a verb. No am.

native.tip: agree فعل، فلا نضع am قبله: “I agree with you.” وليس “I am agree with you.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “I am agree with you.” 😅 agree فعل، فلا نضع am قبله، فالجملة الصحيحة “I agree with you.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “I am agree with you”?
en.tip: agree is a verb, so no am: “I agree with you.” not “I am agree with you.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I am agree with you.” 😅  agree is a verb, so no am, so the right sentence is “I agree with you.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
